question: Can a full-waveform-conditioned stochastic empirical map reduce the complete REAL/SIM gap while retaining source dependence?
input: all8192 existing clean480-point G4 TRAIN waves and c/Q; same R2 masks; no raw step timing claimed
REAL_targets: only2592 TRAIN fit;599 grouped TRAIN validation; no pair labels or paired MSE
initialization: fresh paired generator/critic initial parameters with seed set before constructors; save actual Torch/NumPy/train RNG states and copied initial bytes; old R3B/R8 weights remain reference inputs only

representation.wave_grid: input4801ns CFD-aligned in V; pad8 zeros before and24 zeros after to512 source-description slots, with a known-support mask; padding is not observed extra data
representation.embedding: x/.1V + support mask + relative grid coordinate, c4 and logQsource broadcast
representation.encoder_decoder: stride1 Conv1d kernel5,24channels,seven residual dilated blocks[1,2,4,8,16,32,64],SiLU; no transposed conv/strided upsampling/absolute sinusoid transformer/no batch normalization
representation.mean: mu=exp(g(c))*padded_source + .1V*f_mu(encoder,c); learned signed complete residual without .15 tanh bound, fixed exponential kernel, nonnegative clean constraint, RBF multiplicative correction or source FoM preservation
representation.stochastic_pulse: one16-D event latent plus independent512-D white into learned stride1 conditional temporal branch; .1V is a unit scale, not an amplitude cap; free throughout recorded domain, no clean-peak gate or sqrt law
representation.baseline: separate zero-mean31-tap learned conditional FIR driven by512-D white; condition/event latent may modulate RMS and correlation jointly with pulse; use TRAIN-fit baseline statistics for initialization only, filters remain learnable
representation.interpretation: mu is a baseline response branch, not automatically an identifiable physical conditional expectation; learned latent covariance is empirical, not photon statistics
representation.output: 512 V -> one14bit[-.5,.5] ADC (STE during fit) -> original512 first20% baseline102-point CFD rule ->480 index120 window; padding/clipping/counts and invalid rows retained; no output peak normalization except separately declared shape loss/evaluation

loss.training_critic: independent small spectral-normalized multiscale1-D CNN,24channels, no REAL source PDG/particle pseudolabel/c input; sees unit-bearing waveform and own-shape jointly; one critic step per generator step, hinge loss; not the heldout C2ST
loss.full_joint_SW: TRAIN-fit scaled vector of scalar Qt/PSD/peak/rise/tail plus complete unit-bearing480 curve, own-peak shape, first and second differences;128 fixed unsmoothed projections seed2026100892, blocks balanced by sqrt dimensionality; compare batch distributions only
loss.soft_charge_CDF: reuse R3B eight TRAIN-fit logQ windows/grids and unknown-inclusive conditional PSD CDF; do not maximize FoM or force1/sqrtE
loss.baseline_joint: joint RMS/lag1..8ACF/nonDC spectral shape with Qt/peak; TRAIN-fit scales; no paired waveform target
loss.validation_selection: every100 including0, fixed384 TRAIN internal validation sources/REAL/noise; minimize fixed1SW+2CDF+.5occupancy+.5baseline only, no GAN critic loss/DEV C2ST; hold all projections/scales fixed

paired_ablation.mechanism: same complete-wave architecture and loss, pulse event latent and pulse white disabled; baseline noise remains; draw then discard the same z/white so all source/REAL orders and RNG streams stay paired
paired_ablation.purpose: tests incremental conditional pulse variation within this full-wave route; existing R3B/R8 remain descriptive architecture controls, not a controlled proof of architecture causation

source_dependence_diagnostics.control_1: shuffle entire source bundle x,c,Q together by fixed permutation seed2026100893; keep z/baseline white/pulse white unchanged
source_dependence_diagnostics.control_2: replace entire bundle by first allowed TRAIN-fit source in full-SHA parent ordering, keep noises unchanged; SIM-only control, not a REAL template
source_dependence_diagnostics.report: paired waveform L2 and signed Qt/PSD/peak changes, source-to-output rank/conditional associations, original/all-donor parent provenance; source-ignoring if both controls leave all64 outputs bitwise invariant, otherwise magnitude is descriptive without invented physical tolerance
source_dependence_diagnostics.claim_boundary: sensitivity demonstrates use of source, not unique correct per-event correspondence

joint_evaluation: Qt-PSD2D, width/mean/occupancy/detrended width on fixed supported bins
unit-bearing and own-shape full waveform plus curve bands
baseline RMS/ACF/spectra and signal curvature by charge
source-nominal all parents and output-charge strata/migration separately
fixed independent HGB fullshape/fullvoltage plus strict local views; train/test split by parent/artificial REAL group
saved weights/random input independent main replay
references: old GEN_W0 with its proxy-scale limitation
source_mixture_policy: no posthoc reweighting/HC filtering; original G4 label/energy mix and REAL unlabelled mix can differ; complete population and observable-charge comparisons answer different questions; no claim that domain matching calibrates Geant4 particle labels/source spectrum

budget_proposed.performance: runtime/memory feasibility is an unbenchmarked bounded estimate, not measured here; existing Torch CPU environment suffices to attempt; no install or remote migration

stop_rules: nonfinite loss/output or unrecoverable input role mismatch -> preserve failure, no recipe search
source input-insensitivity -> report failure of mapping requirement even if marginal similarity improves
source mixture/support conflicts cannot be silently solved by relabelling or reweighting
after one recipe/pair all scientific outcomes preserved; remaining gap is a negative result, not authorization for another patch/search
no EVAL for model choice; final frozen retrospective benchmark only after root registration
identifiability: unpaired marginal agreement allows many source-to-output couplings and stochastic laws; full input being a deterministic source description adds an inductive bias, not missing G4 time information or independent detector calibration
